newsitem.title: UK: Royal Bank squeezed up in short shorgage.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank squeezed up in short shorgage.

text.p: Shares in Royal Bank of Scotland Plc were squeezed higher on Thursday as recent weakness in the stock continued to lure buyers, dealers said.
"It had been a good market in the past two or three sessions and there is a bit of a stock shortage," said one market-maker. "It's playing catch-up with the rest of the sector."
Royal Bank shares were up 14-1/2p at 604-1/2 by 0910 GMT in modest volume of 456,696 shares, extending a rally since they tumbled to a five-week low of 568p on June 2.
"There has been a buyer around and the stock is a bit squeezy," said another dealer.
